name: Social Predator
description: Identifies and exploits the socially vulnerable for personal gain
behavioral_signature: Zeroes in on the newest, loneliest, or most desperate person in any group
under_stress: Becomes reckless in targeting, picks fights with stronger prey
at_rest: Scanning for weakness with a pleasant smile
will_never: approach someone who might expose them
unless: the reward outweighs the risk of exposure
